root.label: Jerome Powell remains on Federal Reserve board after chair term

events.label: Jerome Powell remains on Federal Reserve board after chair term

slots.name: board membership
slots.sentence: Powell has remained on the Fed’s board despite the end of his term as chair, breaking with tradition.

slots.name: term end date
slots.sentence: Powell ended his term as Fed chairman in May but can remain on as a voting member of the Fed's Board of Governors through January 2028.
